version.changelog: 1.3.0: zstd for text (archive 6.2x smaller on the CI text profile; missing zstandard now warns instead of silently falling back to deflate), measured process-pool packing with --workers N (2.3-3.7x on real work, 0.76x on tiny inputs so it is chosen only above 16 MiB), vanished files reported as skipped, adaptive buffer measured and rejected, tests 76 -> 83

llm.summary: This skill is a local CloudArc benchmarking workflow with helper scripts that run repository tests and benchmark checks, without hidden credential use, persistence, or network/cloud activation.

dimensions.detail: Local shell/Python execution and file writes are proportionate for benchmark automation. The large manual benchmark is disclosed as costly and gated behind --yes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is described as cloning into the skills directory or installing by registry slug; no post-install hook, remote payload retrieval, dependency installation, or tool replacement is present in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives broad workflow instructions for editing repository files and CI documents, but it repeatedly scopes work to the CloudArc repository, warns against using credentials or proprietary packages, and requires explicit approval for changing SLO contracts or committing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background service, scheduled task, persistent memory write, credential store access, shell profile modification, or privilege escalation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities fit the stated purpose: inspect CloudArc benchmark/protocol files, run local tests and bounded-memory benchmarks, validate telemetry JSON, and generate local benchmark artifacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for CloudArc benchmark and telemetry work. Expect it to run local Python tests/benchmarks and write benchmark reports; avoid running the manual profile unless you intentionally want a long, disk-heavy 1/5/10 GiB benchmark.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill lacks explicit allowed-tool metadata, but the artifact itself scopes activity to repository-local CloudArc benchmarking and explicitly says not to connect credentials, cloud services, or proprietary packages; this is a packaging clarity issue, not evidence of unsafe behavior.
[EA2] expected: The cited text says not to treat packs as complete without checking skipped counts. That is a verification guard, not autonomous high-impact execution.
[AST4] expected: The helper uses subprocess.run with explicit argument lists and shell=False by default to run Python test and benchmark modules in a user-specified repository; this is expected for a benchmark runner.
[TT2] expected: The badge command writes an SVG generated from a benchmark JSON result to a user-selected output path. This is a local artifact-generation feature, not hidden data handling.
